headline: Carousel Mill
title: Carousel Mill | Easy Aniimo Feeding | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Tired of feeding your Aniimo by hand? Build the Carousel Mill in your Homeland. It unlocks at R V level two, and it makes Wheatmeal. Wheatmeal is used to feed your Aniimo, and one guide says it makes feeding far less of a chore. So upgrade your R V to level two, build the mill, and keep Wheatmeal flowing for your workers. Have you built your Carousel Mill yet? Comment below!
description: The Carousel Mill unlocks at RV level 2 in Aniimo's Homeland and makes Wheatmeal, which is used to feed your Aniimo.
joke: My Aniimo ate so well that the mill got jealous.
